## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Only optional corrections were found in the reviewed scope: `test_rejects_legacy_header` passes whatever the header check does. `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` is the test that actually exercises the new strict `REPORT v1` comparison.

## Changes
`parse_report` now accepts only the exact header `REPORT v1` instead of any line that starts with `REPORT `. The pull request also adds two tests that check unsupported headers are rejected.

## Suggestions
- tests/test_report.py:10 — tests — Make the legacy-header test reach the version check — In `test_rejects_legacy_header`, `rsplit("v1", 1)` changes `version=v1` to `version=v0`, so the header stays `REPORT v1`. The fixture also has no `END` line, so `parse_report` returns `None` at `app/report.py:3` before it reaches the header check. The comment at line 9 says the test changes "the fixture's version to v0", but the code changes a body line instead. — This test passes even if the version check is removed, so its name and comment overstate what it protects. — Fix: Use `"REPORT v0\nvalue=ok\nEND"` as the input, or delete this test because `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` already covers that input.
